explained.summary:
His great-grandfather made sure Marcus was taught by good tutors at home instead of being sent to the public schools, and showed him that education is something worth spending generously on.

It’s partly a note about privilege, which Marcus doesn’t hide. The lasting lesson is about priorities: money spent on learning is money well spent.
